description: Defines structures, enums, and function prototypes for hostapd/ubus support, including event handling, interface and BSS management, and notifications via ubus.

classes.name: hostapd_ubus_bss
classes.description: Represents a ubus BSS object with associated data such as ubus object, banned list, and notification response.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_add_iface
methods.description: Adds a network interface to ubus support.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_free_iface
methods.description: Removes a network interface from ubus support.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_add_bss
methods.description: Adds a BSS to ubus support.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_free_bss
methods.description: Removes a BSS from ubus support.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_add_vlan
methods.description: Adds a VLAN to a BSS in ubus.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_remove_vlan
methods.description: Removes a VLAN from a BSS in ubus.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_handle_event
methods.description: Handles a ubus event for a given hapd.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_handle_link_measurement
methods.description: Handles link measurement data received via ubus.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_notify_beacon_report
methods.description: Notifies a beacon report event via ubus.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_notify_radar_detected
methods.description: Notifies radar detection event via ubus.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_notify_bss_transition_response
methods.description: Notifies BSS transition response via ubus.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_free
methods.description: Cleans up ubus support for interfaces.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_notify_bss_transition_query
methods.description: Sends a BSS transition query notification.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_notify_authorized
methods.description: Notifies that a station has been authorized.
